info.name: Kuhle Monitor
info.summary: A Nextcloud dashboard for monitoring employee productivity, task progress, team performance, and work activity.
info.description:
The Employee Productivity Dashboard is a Nextcloud-integrated application designed to help organisations monitor employee productivity, track task completion, manage workloads, and evaluate team performance through a centralised, data-driven interface.
The application provides managers and authorised team leaders with real-time visibility into work progress, project milestones, outstanding tasks, deadlines, and team activity. Employees can view their own productivity metrics, track personal goals, and identify opportunities to improve their work efficiency.
Core Features:
Productivity Overview: Dashboard cards displaying assigned tasks, completed tasks, overdue items, project progress, and completion rates.
Employee Performance: Individual and team-level productivity metrics based on task completion, deadlines, and agreed performance targets.
Task and Project Monitoring: Track work assignments, project milestones, pending activities, and progress over time.
Analytics and Reports: Visual charts showing productivity trends, workload distribution, task completion rates, and performance against targets.
Team Management: Role-based dashboards for employees, team leaders, managers, and administrators.
Activity Timeline: Display relevant work activities and task updates from supported Nextcloud applications.
Notifications and Alerts: Notify users about overdue tasks, approaching deadlines, and project milestones.
Employee Self-Service: Allow employees to review their own metrics, monitor progress, and manage their priorities.
Nextcloud Integration: Integrate with supported Nextcloud applications, including Tasks, Calendar, and Projects or equivalent project-management tools where available.
Privacy and Access Control: Apply role-based permissions, transparent data collection, and appropriate access restrictions for employee information.
Objective: Improve organisational productivity, accountability, workload visibility, and evidence-based management while supporting employee transparency and responsible data governance.
info.author: Nathi Tshabalala
